+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+from app.config import get_setting
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_delete_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    token = params.get("token")
+    admin_token = get_setting("ADMIN_TOKEN")
+    if admin_token is None or token != admin_token:
+        return 403, {"error": "forbidden"}
+    
+    raw_id = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw_id, str) or not raw_id.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    
+    user_id = int(raw_id)
+    if not users.delete_user(user_id):
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    
+    return 200, {"deleted": raw_id}

import os
from app.api.handlers import handle_delete_user
import pytest

def test_delete_user_forbidden_no_token():
    assert handle_delete_user({"id": "1"}) == (403, {"error": "forbidden"})

def test_delete_user_forbidden_wrong_token():
    os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"] = "secret"
    assert handle_delete_user({"id": "1", "token": "wrong"}) == (403, {"error": "forbidden"})

def test_delete_user_invalid_id():
    os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"] = "secret"
    assert handle_delete_user({"id": "abc", "token": "secret"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})

def test_delete_user_not_found():
    os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"] = "secret"
    assert handle_delete_user({"id": "99", "token": "secret"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})

def test_delete_user_success():
    os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"] = "secret"
    assert handle_delete_user({"id": "1", "token": "secret"}) == (200, {"deleted": "1"})
    # Verify it is deleted
    from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
